description: Longest annual sequence of consecutive dry days
Maximum temperature of the warmest month
Total precipitation during the driest three-month period
Maximum number of consecutive months where precipitation is below potential evapotranspiration
An approximation of the WBGT is calculated using the formula in Bernard & Iheanacho (2015). As the approximation is based on the HI under shade conditions
units: an additional 3.5°C is added to the estimated WBGT to account for direct radiant effects.

description: Warmest climatological month sea-surface temperature from the Sabah Marine Vision regional marine climate projections.
classification_method: screening_value_and_change; composite scoring pending marine calibration
interpretation: Higher values generally indicate greater climate stress for this dimension.
limitations: Blue Communities POLCOMS-ERSEM regional marine model; approximately 0.1 degree (~11 km). Coastal extension addresses coarse-grid coastline gaps but does not create fine-scale marine climate information. Do not interpret a relative screening score as ecological damage or fisheries yield loss.
